source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
In your Movement phase, once per turn, this unit may use this ability when it:

- is placed on the battlefield
- finishes a Normal move, an Advance move or a Fall Back move

If it does, pick 1 enemy unit no more than 8" from this unit that it can see, and roll a D6 per **SWOOPING HAWKS** model it contains. Each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on that enemy unit, up to 6 in total.

After each use, this unit cannot be targeted with the Grenade Stratagem until the turn ends.
